note: Independent re-audit against RFC 8671 Section 5.2 ('All mandatory attributes, such as next hop, MUST be either zero or have an empty length if they are unknown at the pre-policy phase completion.') at HEAD. normalizePrePolicyAdjRIBOutBody (bmp_pre_policy_out.go), called on both live handleSenderPrePolicyOut and cacheAdjUpdate, encodes missing ORIGIN/AS_PATH with empty length 0, zero-fills unknown/missing IPv4 NEXT_HOP as 0.0.0.0, encodes unknown MP_REACH_NLRI next hop with length 0 via appendMPReachEmptyNextHop while keeping AFI/SAFI/reserved/NLRI intact, and leaves withdrawals unchanged. Positive TestRFC8671PrePolicyAdjRIBOutNormalizesUnknownMandatoryAttrs verifies all four paths (IPv4 unknown next hop, missing ORIGIN/AS_PATH/NEXT_HOP, IPv6 MP_REACH empty next hop, and primeSender replay) on decoded wire frames. Negative TestRFC8671PrePolicyAdjRIBOutPreservesKnownMandatoryAttrsAndWithdrawals proves known IPv4/IPv6 mandatory attributes are preserved byte-for-byte verbatim and withdrawal-only UPDATEs gain no mandatory attributes.
